artworks.title: Sunset—Gowanus Bay
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image features a dock with a large ship close by, surrounded by wooden pilings. The horizon is low in the background, with calm seas stretching outwards. Smaller sailing vessels, including a steamboat, can be seen on the horizon. The brushstrokes are fine, capturing the water's texture and ship details. The color palette consists of sepia tones, creating an antiquated feel. The sky is overcast with wispy clouds, enhancing the scene's serene yet industrial atmosphere.

artworks.title: Egeria
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person kneeling on one knee with the other leg tucked underneath, slightly turned to the side. The person has long, wavy hair and is holding their hair with one hand. The person is nude and has a serene expression, with eyes looking down. The background shows dense foliage, and the figure is on a stone or marble surface.

artworks.title: Easthampton
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a pathway running parallel to trees and a building on the left. The path extends into the distance, gradually narrowing. The artwork features detailed cross-hatching and linear strokes to depict shadows and textures on the ground and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black on cream or tan paper. The tree trunks are dense with foliage, casting shadows on the path. A building with wooden siding and windows is partially hidden by trees on the left. A low wooden fence borders the pathway. In the background, there are shadowy silhouettes of more trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Old Lace
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view looking down towards a body of water. A small boat is floating on the water, depicted with textured brushstrokes. A stone bridge with lattice railings spans the horizon line, with trees and buildings in the background. The brushstrokes are light and refined, emphasizing texture. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Fishing Boats
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts a view of boats on the water from a low perspective. Various boats of different sizes are visible in the scene. The horizon is placed high in the composition, with a distant array of ship masts fading into a hazy skyline. Delicate etchings create a rich texture in depicting the boats and their reflections in the water. The color palette consists mainly of sepia tones, offering an old-world, nostalgic atmosphere. A large sailing vessel is closest to the viewer, with other boats scattered across the calm water.

artworks.title: The Noonday Rest
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow, semi-enclosed space resembling a stable or barn. A horse is tethered near the entrance with a canine resting nearby. Further inside, another horse and a group of animals or figures can be seen. The scene is depicted with intricate brushstrokes defining textures, in a monochromatic palette of black, sepia, and off-white. The composition does not feature a traditional horizon.

artworks.title: George Washington
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a head and partial shoulder portrait of a person in profile facing to the right. The individual has a pronounced nose and a slightly rounded chin, with light-colored hair styled in a classical manner and tied back with a ribbon, adorned with a laurel wreath. The person is wearing a dark garment only visible around the neckline. The background features an oval frame with a laurel pattern. There are torch-like symbols in circular laurel wreaths in the top corners. Below the main portrait, there is a smaller portrait encased in an oval, and the signature "Max Rosenthal" and the number "No.12" are visible.

artworks.title: Beech Forest
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image showcases a woodland area with dense foliage and textured tree trunks. The horizon is obscured by the thick forest, creating a sense of depth. The trees and undergrowth recede into the distance. A monochromatic palette of black and gray emphasizes intricate detailing, light play, and a serene atmosphere. A small stream winding through the middle reflects light and draws the eye into the forested distance.

artworks.title: Cutting In
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This image shows a sailing ship from the side, with masts reaching into the sky. The viewpoint is slightly angled, capturing the ship from a side and elevated perspective. The ship is positioned left of center with partially unfurled sails. The ocean horizon is low, emphasizing the sky. A smaller ship is seen on the horizon to the right. The background features a vast sky with birds in flight, creating a sense of movement. The color palette is black, white, and gray. The etching technique depicts detailed lines for the sails and rigging, adding texture and depth. Gentle shading and contrast highlight the ship's presence on the sea.

artworks.title: The Girl and Kitten
artworks.medium: stipple engraving and etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl holding a kitten. She is seated with a slight forward lean, wearing a dress with long sleeves and a hat. The background features a draped fabric and a landscape painting or decorative element.

artworks.title: Westminster Abbey, View of the Chancel from the South Transept
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior of a historical building. It depicts a chancel with intricate details of arched structures and patterns on stonework, showcasing a Gothic architectural style with pointed arches and elaborate detailing. The drawing captures the textures and solemn atmosphere within the space, reflecting its historical and artistic significance.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Closed Eyes
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly woman in profile. Only the upper third of her body is depicted, focusing on her head and shoulders. The woman is positioned facing left, her gaze directed downward. Her facial features include deeply etched lines and wrinkles, and she has a calm, composed expression. Her hair is neatly pulled back and covered with a cap. She wears a simple garment around her neck, possibly a scarf, tied in a knot at the front. The background is plain with a light texture.

artworks.title: Les Deux Bourrines
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1934)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a low horizon line allowing the sky to dominate the top half. The sky is filled with swirling patterns. In the foreground, figures are engaged in rural activities, possibly harvesting. There are two thatched-roof houses to the right, while a cluster of trees and a windmill are on the left. The color palette is sepia, giving the image an earthy quality. The style appears to be an etching, with detailed line work depicting natural and manmade elements in the scene.

artworks.title: Un Monsieur tenant à prouver qu'il peut...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person playing the piano and singing with enthusiasm, surrounded by onlookers. The scene portrays the energetic performance with exaggerated features and expressive poses, rendered in a caricature style.

artworks.title: Men in a Rowboat
artworks.medium: black ink wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a small rowboat on open water with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is indistinct, blending into the sky. Three figures are in the rowboat, with one standing and waving a hat. The boat is right of center, emphasizing the surrounding empty space. Delicate strokes are used, with detailed focus on the boat and figures. The color palette is mainly gray and black against a light tan background. Subtle shading suggests ripples on the water.

artworks.title: Study for "Militia Training" [recto]
artworks.medium: black ink wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures interacting in a confrontational manner. The figures are engaged in a tense scene, where two figures on the left and right each hold a pole that crosses the body of a central figure dressed in military uniform. The central figure appears to be off balance, suggesting motion or struggle. The figures are drawn with detailed and expressive lines. The muted palette and loose sketch style focus attention on the figures' movement and expressions.

artworks.title: Seascape and Landscape
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image features two pencil sketches on a single sheet. The top sketch shows a tranquil water view with a small boat on the left and trees in the background. The lower sketch, enclosed in an oval, depicts a pastoral landscape with a path, a house emitting smoke, and tall trees. Both sketches use soft pencil strokes to create a grayscale color palette, emphasizing form and depth.

artworks.title: Study for "The Return of King Friedrich II from Küstrin"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: This is a sketch depicting a romantic scene with two figures. One figure is standing or sitting on a raised surface, while the other is on one knee, leaning towards the first figure. The standing figure is depicted as a woman in a voluminous dress, with loosely drawn hair curls. The kneeling figure is dressed in a long coat with striped pants. There are unfinished elements around the main duo. The background is plain with no extra details. The sketch is on textured paper, possibly with faint handwriting.

artworks.title: Men in Seventeenth-Century Costumes [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting a group of seated individuals in profile. The drawing shows the figures' full bodies with varying levels of detail in their clothing and facial features. The individuals are wearing period-appropriate attire such as tall hats, loose-fitting garments with collars and capes. They have different facial features including beards and hairstyles of different lengths and styles. The setting lacks a detailed background, with a focus solely on the individuals. There is minimal shading and no color in the sketch.

artworks.title: Ponte Vecchio, Florence [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Monastery [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with buildings, potentially a village, amidst trees. A church with a steeple is visible. The horizon divides the land from the sky. The drawing showcases a monochromatic color palette with soft, grainy textures created using pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Flowering Bush and Desert Plants
artworks.artist: American 19th Century after John Frederick Kensett
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a ground-level view depicted in a sketch-like pencil drawing. There is no visible horizon line. The composition focuses on plants across a flat expanse of ground. Details of wildflowers and grass clumps are rendered with fine strokes, giving a delicate, textured appearance. The color palette is muted, consisting of the paper's beige tone and the natural gray of the pencil. The background shows more tufts of grass with less detail than the foreground plants.

artworks.title: Weser
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with a low horizon line, depicting an extensive terrain. The mountains span the horizon, rising sharply on each side. In the center, a valley is enclosed by the mountains. The drawing is in light pencil sketches, creating an airy look. Delicate, even strokes outline the mountains, valleys, and sparse vegetation. The subdued color palette includes shades of grey with soft whites and light blush tints. The foreground is mostly barren with sparse vegetation, leading the eye towards detailed mountain peaks in the distance.

artworks.title: William Wilson Corcoran
artworks.medium: pen, brush, and black ink with gouache on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing upright and holding a hat in his left hand. He has a stern expression and distinct facial features, including a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, and a prominent nose. He is dressed in a formal suit with a coat, waistcoat, and trousers. In his right hand, he holds a walking stick. The background is mostly blank with some shading and sketchy lines around the figure.
